name: publishes-advisory
definition: The subject vendor or organization releases or issues a security advisory or patch update.

name: fixes-vulnerability-in
definition: The subject security advisory or update remediates vulnerabilities found in the object software product.

name: affects
definition: The subject vulnerability or malware impacts, targets, or compromises the object software, system, or organization.

name: located-in
definition: The subject entity is based in, operates within, or belongs to the object country or geographic area.

name: part-of
definition: The head entity is a component, sub-application, or structural member of the tail entity.

name: hosts
definition: The subject network infrastructure, host, or server hosts or provides access to the object resource or payload.

name: delivers
definition: The subject malware, file, or campaign installs, drops, or initiates the execution of the object malware payload.

name: redirects-to
definition: The subject script, webpage, or file redirects user traffic or execution to the object URL or host.

name: exploits
definition: The subject threat actor or malware leverages or abuses the object security vulnerability to compromise systems.

name: uses
definition: The subject threat actor or malware utilizes the object tool, infrastructure, or malware.
